extracted.name: Pineapple Angel Food Cake
extracted.description: This pineapple angel food cake is a quick and easy dessert to make with just 3 prepared ingredients: cake mix, canned pineapple, and whipped topping.
ingredient_lines: 1 (20 ounce) can crushed pineapple with juice
1 (16 ounce) package angel food cake mix
1 (12 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instruction_lines: Gather the ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Spray a 9x13-inch pan with cooking spray.
Mix pineapple with juice and cake mix together in a large bowl until well combined; pour batter into the prepared pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 25 minutes. Let cake cool; serve with whipped topping.
